purpose: side-effect-free planning between Store/catalog presentation and the future authorized platform install executor

inputs.artifact_identity: exact verified runtime-component release/2 reference: appId + version + sourceRepository + sourceCommit + releaseEnvelopeSha256 + packageSha256 + compatibilitySha256 + verified/compatible observations
inputs.production_activation_policy: platform read-only readiness checker exists, but planner accepts no caller assertion; readiness remains blocked until a trusted runtime observation contract is injected from the platform owner
inputs.artifact_source_semantics: verified/compatible are read-only platform observations; they do not mint authority and a future executor must independently reverify the signed envelope, canonical source, compatibility, trust and activation policy

next_gate: define a trusted platform runtime readiness observation/port sourced from canonical runtime-component production readiness, then let the authority-free planner consume that observation; a separate Native executor must still reverify the exact release plus fresh authorization before mutation
